messages.subject: how to create areas mapplot
parts:
Hi!

I hope someone can can point me in the right direction since I didnt
find the right google-search to show me the way.

I am working on a volunteering project vor boyscouts
(www.stayscout.de) and we want to display a (google) map with the
working-area of our groups (similar to district-areas).
But how do I create those area-data easily?
Is there an webapp that can help me out here?
Ideal would be an app that I can send my users to to create their own
area-lines and send them back to me later.

Thanks, regards and "Gut Pfad"
Tobias

Tobias, I think you have the wrong group (unless you are trying to do
something in R with ggplot2, which does not seem to be the case). I
think you want Google Earth as likely the easiest route. Should be
straight forward for everyone to define their own polygons and sent them
to you. If this is the case, questions back to this group are mis-directed.
